cues.am: በትምህርት ቤቱ ግድግዳ ላይ ቅርጾች ተስለዋል። ጎኖቻቸውን እንቁጠር።
cues.en: Shapes are painted on the school wall. Let us count their sides.
A square has four equal sides.

cues.am: ባለ አምስት ጎን አምስት፣ ባለ ስድስት ጎን ደግሞ ስድስት ጎኖች አሏቸው።
cues.en: A pentagon has five sides and a hexagon has six.
A circle has no sides and no corners.
